entities.name: Nevis Secession Referendum
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Long-simmering Nevisian desires for independence from Saint Kitts culminated in a secession referendum on August 10, 1998. The vote favored secession 61.7% to 38.3%, but fell short of the required two-thirds supermajority. Tensions between the islands have continued intermittently.
